evidenceBoundary.exact: Current parent owned bulk bytes, selected complete dispatch/snapshot/vector blocks, complete small target leaves and three raw dword RVA tables.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Unsigned small count directly indexes the small table; rounded vector length supplies its bounded table index. Both current mode branches join selected complete copy payloads and plain returns.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Every integer byte count under the selected bounds is proved with distinct symbolic initial-source bytes. Requires parent same-element selections, valid stable non-wrapping memory/code/tables, supported instruction state, frame and optional bitset disjointness and successful normal completion; interleaved vector copies require destination <= source or destination >= source + length.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous mode and live class-stride operands remain representations; stored raw tables do not measure live selection.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Larger vector loops, non-temporal and backward paths, live stride/provider and allocation/alias lifetime, general resize old-value preservation, renderer/parent joins and observed execution.
